regions.original: 名寄遠別線・板谷峠の台線
regions.translation: Nayoro Enbetsu Line and Itayatōge Daiko Line
regions.breakdown: 名寄 (Nayoro): Place name. 遠別 (Enbetsu): Place name. 線 (sen): Line, route. ・: Separator. 板谷峠 (Itayatōge): Mountain pass name. の (no): Possessive particle. 台線 (Daiko-sen): Line, route.

regions.original: この先通り抜けはできません。
regions.breakdown: この先 (kono saki): Ahead, beyond this point. 通り抜け (tōrinuke): Passing through, through passage. は (wa): Topic particle. できません (dekimasen): Cannot do (negative potential form of する 'suru' - to do, polite form).
名寄 (Nayoro): Place name. 遠別 (Enbetsu): Place name. 線 (sen): Line, route. (The adjacent 'no entry' sign with '通行止' indicates this line is closed).
板谷峠 (Itayatōge): Mountain pass name. の (no): Possessive particle. 台線 (Daiko-sen): Line, route. (The adjacent 'no entry' sign with '通行止' indicates this line is closed).

where_youd_see_it: On a road, indicating that certain routes or sections are closed or have no through passage.
cultural_note: Japanese road signs often use explicit '通行止' (Tsūkōdome, Road Closed) in conjunction with 'no entry' symbols to clearly indicate impassable routes, sometimes due to weather, construction, or road conditions.
